Mari brand & UX style guide03 — Type
▪ 03 — Shape & texture

Two deliberate modes

The brand identity and the app console use different shape rules on purpose. Both are correct — pick the one matching where you're building.

Brand mode

Marketing site, landing pages, social assets

Radius 0px. Hard offset block shadow, 4px 4px 0 ink. Buttons press into the page on click.

Get started

App / console mode

Product UI, dashboards, dense data screens

Radius 4–6px. No shadows anywhere. Separation comes from hairline ink/15 borders only.

Get started

Dot-matrix texture

22px grid, wash only
radial-gradient(ink 0.07–0.14, transparent) / 22px 22px

Never a solid fill. Never on small/dense UI (buttons, chips, rows). Large surfaces only: page background, hero sections, empty states.

Spacing scale

4px base

4 · 8 · 12 · 16 · 24 · 32 · 48px

▪ 04 — Rules

Do / don't

Iconography is lucide-react only. Voice is plainspoken, genuine, dry wit, no mascot. Full voice guide: mari/web/web/STYLE.md.

DoDon't
One espelette accent per screenEspelette as a repeated decorative color
Inter + JetBrains Mono onlyAny serif, any third typeface
Hairline ink borders for separationSoft drop shadows in app/console UI
lucide-react iconsHand-drawn, plant, or "sketch filter" icons
Sharp corners (0 brand / 4–6px app)Large rounded corners, pill-shaped cards
Dot-matrix as a faint background washDot-matrix as a solid fill or on small UI
Semantic 5-tone status scaleAd-hoc new colors for "just this one badge"
Active voice, sentence case, serial commaTitle Case headings, passive voice, hype
